name: 3-methylamphetamine
summary: 3-Methylamphetamine (3-MeA; code name PAL-314) is a stimulant drug from the amphetamine family. It is self-administered by mice to a similar extent to 4-fluoroamphetamine (4-FA) and has comparable properties as a monoamine releaser, although with a more balanced release of all three monoamines, as opposed to the more dopamine/noradrenaline-selective fluoro analogues.
